title: Sindhu Wins Japan Open Title, Ends Drought with Scorching Victory
indian_angle: PV Sindhu's victory at the Japan Open marks a significant return to form and ends a title drought for the Indian badminton star.
summary: PV Sindhu clinched her maiden Japan Open title with a dominant performance against home contender Akane Yamaguchi, signaling a strong comeback.

title: Sai Praneeth's Historic Bronze: Ending India's 36-Year Wait at Worlds
indian_angle: This feature revisits B Sai Praneeth's memorable achievement of securing India's first men's singles World Championships medal in 36 years.
summary: A look back at B Sai Praneeth's bronze medal win at the 2019 World Championships, a landmark moment for Indian men's singles badminton.

title: PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty Exit China Open After Wasting Match Points
indian_angle: Top Indian shuttlers PV Sindhu and rising star Ayush Shetty faced early exits from the China Open Super 1000, despite holding match points.
summary: PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty both lost their respective matches at the China Open Super 1000, with Sindhu frittering away four match points against Chen Yufei.

title: Ayush Shetty Triumphs Over Alwi Farhan in China Open Clash
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Ayush Shetty secured a notable victory against Alwi Farhan at the China Open, showcasing his potential on the international stage.
summary: Ayush Shetty defeated Alwi Farhan in a promising encounter at the China Open, highlighting a battle between two emerging stars.

title: BAI Announces Eligibility Criteria for World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: Badminton Association of India has released the player eligibility guidelines for Indian participants in the upcoming World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The BAI has issued a circular detailing the eligibility requirements for Indian players aspiring to compete in the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: A significant change in scoring, adopting the 3x15 system, has been implemented for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
